item.description:
Blinky 1.5.39

  • Antigravity 最多显示三个分组圆环，并可逐组关闭。 在「设置 → 供应商」打开 Antigravity 账号的「外观」，打开「按模型分组拆成多个圆环」后，Gemini 4 Argon 的每周额度单独显示为一个圆环，不需要的分组可以单独关闭。#106
  • 只安装了 Gemini.app 时也能读取 Antigravity。 Blinky 使用 Gemini.app 自带的 agy 读取额度。#106
  • 没有 Coding Plan 的小米账号显示预存余额。 圆环显示余额，可在该账号的设置里选择圆环的计算方式，并设置低余额提醒。#82
  • Command Code 工作时圆环会显示活动标记。 Command Code 正在工作时，圆环上显示转动的标记，与 Claude Code 和 Codex 相同。
  • 带登录信息的请求不再跟随跨站跳转。 读取 Qoder、StepFun、小米、OpenCode Go 和 Claude Desktop 时，登录 Cookie 不会再随跳转发到其他网站。
  • 切换站点后不再写回旧站点的登录信息。 从浏览器读取登录信息期间切换 Qoder 或 StepFun 的站点，这次读取的结果会被丢弃。
  • 更换 Z.ai 或智谱的密钥后，卡片会重新读取用量记录。 卡片不再继续显示上一个账号的历史。
  • 额外账号续期失败时不再误报已退出登录。 网络中断、限流或服务端错误时保留上次的读数；只有登录被拒绝时才提示重新登录。
  • Command Code 的 deepseek-v4.1-flash 可以估算金额。 按 models.dev 上 Command Code 公布的价格计算。
  • 用量记录从第一天起就显示每日柱状图。 「设置」中的用量记录与面板卡片一样，从有记录的第一天起画出每日柱状图。

在 GitHub 查看更新说明

Blinky 1.5.39

  • Antigravity shows up to three group rings, and each can be switched off. Under Settings → Providers, open an Antigravity account's Appearance and turn on A ring for each model group: Gemini 4 Argon's weekly allowance gets a ring of its own, and any group can be left off the panel. #106
  • Gemini.app's own agy is read. With only Gemini.app installed, Blinky reads Antigravity's allowances through the agy it ships. #106
  • A Xiaomi account with no Coding Plan shows its prepaid balance. The ring shows the balance, and that account's settings choose how the ring is counted and when the low-balance line appears. #82
  • Command Code shows when it is working. While Command Code is working, its ring shows the turning mark, as Claude Code's and Codex's do.
  • A request that carries a sign-in no longer follows a redirect to another site. When Qoder, StepFun, Xiaomi, OpenCode Go and Claude Desktop are read, the sign-in cookie is not sent on to another site by a redirect.
  • Switching sites no longer saves the previous site's sign-in. A browser read still in progress when Qoder's or StepFun's site is switched is discarded.
  • Changing Z.ai's or Zhipu's key reads the card's history again. The card no longer shows the previous account's history.
  • A failed renewal of an added account no longer reads as signed out. A dropped network, rate limiting or a server error keeps the last reading; only a refused sign-in asks to sign in again.
  • Command Code's deepseek-v4.1-flash is priced. It is estimated at the rates models.dev lists for Command Code.
  • Usage history shows its chart from the first day. The usage history in Settings draws its daily bars from the first day of records, as the panel card does.
